instruction: Deprecate passing None as the cache of the cachetools.cached decorator: cachetools.cached(None)(func), with or without info=True, must emit a DeprecationWarning (message '@cachetools.cached(cache=None) is deprecated') when the function is decorated, attributed to the code doing the decorating. The decorated function keeps working exactly as before: it calls func every time, its cache attribute is None, cache_key and cache_lock are as before, cache_clear() is a no-op and cache_info() counts every call as a miss. Decorating with a real cache emits no warning.
